items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: Then after I began to work for Beans and Rick and Ford and them at the Astro, they called it Tik Tok.

ctx.x: Did you have another, well there's one guy named Shots back there.

Yeah that's who I'm talking about, Shots. That's who I'm talking about, Shots. Yeah, Shots used to go back there. Well I was trying to fool with clan that then. Now you're coming back, now you're talking about the tailgate. Tailgate time man, one of the bass and the tram owners sitting back on the tailgate. We used to use the furniture wagons. When I first started though they had horses. They used no truck. They used horses because we used to advertise for show down here on N-H street. And they started there, we…
Where did you have the drums on the wagon?
